clinics.raw_notes: Status: Accepting new patients for nurse practitioner clinics in London, Middlesex, Elgin, and Oxford. Requirements to join: Name, Ontario health care number, and contact information (phone number, email address, mailing address). Phone: 519-473-0530 ext. 2197. Hours to call/register: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Languages: Page available in English and French (EN/FR toggle). OHIP/UHIP/uninsured policy: Page mentions needing an 'Ontario health care number' but does not explicitly detail UHIP or uninsured patient policies. Registration method: Both phone and online form available (TVFHT Attachment Team Contact Request form on page). No waitlist URL found; the clinic is accepting new patients directly via phone or the on-page contact form.

clinics.name: Wonderland South Medical Centre
clinics.evidence_quote: Please note we are limited to the number of patients we can register and there is no guarantee that all applications can be accepted.
clinics.raw_notes: Documents/requirements needed: The fillable/printable PDF application asks for Health Card # and Version code (implies OHIP card information required). All fields must be answered; incomplete forms will not be reviewed. Patients need to fill out past medical history, current medications, recent family physician, and referral source. The clinic phone number is (519) 472-2060. Fax number is (519) 471-7299. Hours to call or register are NOT listed on the page or in the PDF. Languages spoken are NOT listed. OHIP: implied accepted (health card number requested) but not explicitly stated. UHIP acceptance is NOT mentioned. Uninsured patients: NOT mentioned. Submission method: printable PDF form to be faxed to (519) 471-7299; no online submission form provided. For large medical records (over 20 pages), patients are instructed to mail in print or USB.
